selection_authority: Eight exact Wikimedia Commons files were selected and visually source-audited before any PB7 OCR or ADE20K semantic call. Every exact filename and every frozen English or Chinese entity name had zero hits under research/active/l10-r0. The cohort is entity-disjoint from PB1-PB6 and the prior portal-lattice inventories.

cohort.name: Cityplaza
cohort.source_audit_note: The bilingual identity mark is centered above multiple complete glass door leaves; a tree partially occludes the middle entrance.

cohort.commons_file: Entrance of Hong Kong Public Records Building.JPG
cohort.source_audit_note: High-contrast bilingual entity text and a glass entrance are visible in the same frame; the entrance is small and near the left edge.

freeze_rules.identity_profiles: The aliases above are frozen before OCR. LCSD, MTR Malls, FEHD, MTR, historical filename phrases, and unrelated co-brands are excluded from entity aliases.
freeze_rules.portal_roles: Rows 1-4 are door-level positives, 5-6 contain no portal pixels, and 7-8 are large doorless open-entrance OOD controls.
freeze_rules.model_access: No OCR, ADE20K semantic model, portal proposer, or identity model may run before local source integrity and human portal truth are frozen.

claim_boundary: Deliberately identity-opportunity-stratified, entity-disjoint public-image cohort. It can confirm conditional current-frame identity plus broad-domain door-component behavior, not natural prevalence, physical ownership, public access, traversability, active-view causality, guidance, arrival, product benefit, user benefit, or safety.
